meta.gate: Phase 0 passes only when at least expected_decisions accept/reject verdicts exist and zero provisionally accepted decisions were rejected. The validator fails closed; nothing here marks the gate as met.
meta.instructions: Append one object to "verdicts" per decision you check, in any order; partial review is expected and resumable. Required keys: decision_id, verdict, reviewer, reviewed_at (ISO 8601 with a UTC offset), note. A note is mandatory for reject and needs_more_evidence. Do not edit meta: the validator recomputes the golden-set hash and refuses any verdict file bound to different inputs.
